notes.title: How to play the Halloween version
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31853183/47c8e7b199723fee9cdb2229fda793a1e794ea13.png

Hello everyone!

Halloween is gone, and so are the restless spirits and jack o' lanterns that roam in the night.
Dormont is now back to normal - as if that town can ever be considered normal, of course.

The original version is now back to the main branch of the game, but that doesn't mean that you can't revisit the Halloween night.
We've moved this version to the 'halloween' beta branch. 
If you want to play it, right click on the game on the library, click PROPERTIES, CLICK BETAS and select 'halloween'

Keep the lights on 🕯️

notes.title: Those Who Remain Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Those Who Remain received a devilish free update on Steam, and locals have reported the appearance of menacing jack o' lanterns, but who knows what else may be lurking in the shadows of Dormont...

[previewyoutube=s-lhcSYmcSM;full][/previewyoutube]

Take to the streets of Dormont once again, and see what horrors await you as Halloween twists the shadows into something darker than before - then share your scariest clips and screenshots with us on Twitter with the #ThoseWhoRemain for chances to win the brand new Wired Horror Bundle!

Those Who Remain Digital Comic Free for Steam Users

Additionally as part of our Halloween celebrations, the prequel comic 'Lights Out' that details the events leading right up to the start of the game is now free for all Steam owners of Those Who Remain.

Visit Dormont once more and unravel the mystery behind the terrors that inhabit the darkness, if you keep your wits - you may just survive the night.....

notes.title: Version 1.018
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

We've just rolled out a new update, with some bug fixes and additional language support.
- Fixed issue where the player could die inside the toilet in Mark's house;
- Fixed issue where the player could die in the porch in Desmond's house;
- Fixed issue where a light wouldn't turn on after flipping the switch on the Sawmill.
- Fixed a number of issues on the Italian translation. There was a mix-up on some sentences that Chiara, our ever vigilant Italian translator brought to our attention (sentences that weren't originally translated by her). 
- Added Hungarian support. Hello barátok! (we hope that's correct).
Localization provided by Brechler Zsolt, an awesome member of our community. 

Stay safe everyone, and of course, keep the lights on 🕯️

Those Who Remain Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

There have been a couple of changes brought about in light of the current pandemic situation and we wanted to keep you all informed.

The COVID-19 pandemic is an extraordinary situation. As a team our primary concerns are with our players, team members, developers, and our friends in retail around the world, in what is a challenging time for everyone involved.

As a result of these challenges, Those Who Remain will now launch later in June 2020 both digitally on PC, in addition to our PlayStation 4 and Xbox One launch. This will enable us to ensure the game is able to be released to all territories on time without disappointment.

We appreciate that for many people this will be disappointing, and want to emphasise that we have not made this decision lightly - we are eager to get you onto the streets of Dormont as soon as possible!

We'll continue to communicate any updates and changes as they develop.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
Those Who Remain started with a very simple premise. We wanted to create a game where we could play around with lights and darkness; where the player would die if he stepped into the dark. It all started with this simple idea.

It sounded great on paper, but when we built a prototype to test the mechanics... it just didn't work. Light gets gradually dark, so it's impossible to visually explain to the player where it's safe and where it's dangerous.
So we scrapped the original plan, but kept working on the same idea, a game where darkness would be dangerous.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31853183/8c6e168130097e40c8e3a47b66f5b7688a3399d4.gif

But we added so much more: dimensional portals; moral choices; different endings; 
and the game grew and grew and three years later, here we are now, announcing with great excitement that the game will release on May 15th.

So, very soon you'll be able to play as Edward and visit the accursed Dormont and find out what the hell is going on with that place. 
Why is Edward in Dormont? Why is everything dark? What are these strange portals? 
Too many questions, but if you get what it takes to get to the end, you'll get the answers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31853183/8caa3899289d36958dcc0f69cae2b30b351cd582.gif

It's been a lot of work, and it wouldn't have been possible to have the game as it is today without the help of our great partners: Wired Productions and Whisper Games.

The countdown starts - we hope to see you in Dormont.

Sending our love from PAX East!
